title: Redeploy ChatticusThinTurn so claim and fence are live
description: main (v0.2.0) has POST /turns/{id}/claim and fenced chunk writes. The AWS stack was last exercised as the computerless Luna thin turn. Redeploy ChatticusThinTurn before treating ownership as live. Do not destroy ChatticusSnapshots or ChatticusComputers.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Redeploy target is the development stack ChatticusThinTurn. Do not use cdk deploy --all. Staging and production stay undeployed until their promotion step.
